full_judgment: 13. Land included within the periphery of a hat or Bazar is usually known as "Chandina" land. "Chandina" or Bazar lands are non-agricultural lands and, as such, the same is out side the scope of section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950.
